paragraphs.en: Fast and extensible multi-platform HTTP/1-2-3 web server with automatic HTTPS
paragraphs.zh: 快速且可扩展的多平台 HTTP/1-2-3 Web 服务器，支持自动 HTTPS

paragraphs.en: Caddy is an extensible server platform that uses TLS by default.
paragraphs.zh: Caddy 是一个可扩展的服务器平台，默认使用 TLS。

paragraphs.en: The simplest, cross-platform way to get started is to download Caddy from GitHub Releases and place the executable file in your PATH.
paragraphs.zh: 最简单、跨平台的入门方式是从 GitHub Releases 下载 Caddy，并将可执行文件放入你的 PATH 中。

paragraphs.en: See our online documentation for other install instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅我们的在线文档了解其他安装说明。

paragraphs.en: Note: These steps will not embed proper version information . For that, please follow the instructions in the next section.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：这些步骤不会嵌入正确的版本信息。 为此，请按照下一节中的说明操作。

sents.en: Note: These steps will not embed proper version information .
sents.zh: 注意：这些步骤不会嵌入正确的版本信息。

sents.en: For that, please follow the instructions in the next section.
sents.zh: 为此，请按照下一节中的说明操作。

paragraphs.en: $ git clone " https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy.git " $ cd caddy/cmd/caddy/ $ go build When you run Caddy, it may try to bind to low ports unless otherwise specified in your config. If your OS requires elevated privileges for this, you will need to give your new binary permission to do so. On Linux, this can be done easily with: sudo setcap cap_net_bind_service=+ep ./caddy
paragraphs.zh: $ git clone " https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy.git " $ cd caddy/cmd/caddy/ $ go build 当你运行 Caddy 时，除非在配置中另有指定，否则它可能会尝试绑定低端口。 如果你的操作系统对此要求提升的权限，你需要给你的新二进制文件授予相应权限。 在 Linux 上，这可以用以下命令轻松完成：sudo setcap cap_net_bind_service=+ep ./caddy

sents.en: $ git clone " https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy.git " $ cd caddy/cmd/caddy/ $ go build When you run Caddy, it may try to bind to low ports unless otherwise specified in your config.
sents.zh: $ git clone " https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy.git " $ cd caddy/cmd/caddy/ $ go build 当你运行 Caddy 时，除非在配置中另有指定，否则它可能会尝试绑定低端口。

sents.en: If your OS requires elevated privileges for this, you will need to give your new binary permission to do so.
sents.zh: 如果你的操作系统对此要求提升的权限，你需要给你的新二进制文件授予相应权限。

sents.en: On Linux, this can be done easily with: sudo setcap cap_net_bind_service=+ep ./caddy
sents.zh: 在 Linux 上，这可以用以下命令轻松完成：sudo setcap cap_net_bind_service=+ep ./caddy

paragraphs.en: If you prefer to use go run which only creates temporary binaries, you can still do this with the included setcap.sh like so:
paragraphs.zh: 如果您更倾向于使用只会创建临时二进制文件的 go run，仍然可以使用附带的 setcap.sh 来实现，操作如下：

paragraphs.en: $ go run -exec ./setcap.sh main.go If you don't want to type your password for setcap , use sudo visudo to edit your sudoers file and allow your user account to run that command without a password, for example:
paragraphs.zh:
```
$ go run -exec ./setcap.sh main.go
```

如果你不想在执行 `setcap` 时输入密码，可以使用 `sudo visudo` 编辑你的 sudoers 文件，允许你的用户账户在无需密码的情况下运行该命令，例如：

paragraphs.en: username ALL=(ALL:ALL) NOPASSWD: /usr/sbin/setcap replacing username with your actual username. Please be careful and only do this if you know what you are doing! We are only qualified to document how to use Caddy, not Go tooling or your computer, and we are providing these instructions for convenience only; please learn how to use your own computer at your own risk and make any needful adjustments.

paragraphs.en: Then you can run the tests in all modules or a specific one:
paragraphs.zh: 然后你就可以在所有模块或某个特定模块中运行测试了：

paragraphs.en: $ go test ./... $ go test ./modules/caddyhttp/tracing/ With version information and/or plugins Using our builder tool, xcaddy ...
paragraphs.zh: $ go test ./... $ go test ./modules/caddyhttp/tracing/ 包含版本信息和/或插件 使用我们的构建工具 xcaddy ...

paragraphs.en: The Caddy website has documentation that includes tutorials, quick-start guides, reference, and more.
paragraphs.zh: Caddy 网站提供的文档包括教程、快速入门指南、参考等内容。

paragraphs.zh: 我们建议所有用户——无论经验水平如何——都阅读我们的《入门指南》，以熟悉如何使用 Caddy。

paragraphs.en: Caddy is most often used as an HTTPS server, but it is suitable for any long-running Go program. First and foremost, it is a platform to run Go applications. Caddy "apps" are just Go programs that are implemented as Caddy modules. Two apps -- tls and http -- ship standard with Caddy.
paragraphs.zh: Caddy 最常被用作 HTTPS 服务器，但它也适用于任何长时间运行的 Go 程序。 首先，它是一个运行 Go 应用程序的平台。 Caddy 的「应用（apps）」只是以 Caddy 模块形式实现的 Go 程序。 两个应用——tls 和 http——随 Caddy 标准发行。

sents.en: Caddy is most often used as an HTTPS server, but it is suitable for any long-running Go program.
sents.zh: Caddy 最常被用作 HTTPS 服务器，但它也适用于任何长时间运行的 Go 程序。

sents.en: First and foremost, it is a platform to run Go applications.
sents.zh: 首先，它是一个运行 Go 应用程序的平台。

sents.en: Caddy "apps" are just Go programs that are implemented as Caddy modules.
sents.zh: Caddy 的「应用（apps）」只是以 Caddy 模块形式实现的 Go 程序。

sents.en: Two apps -- tls and http -- ship standard with Caddy.
sents.zh: 两个应用——tls 和 http——随 Caddy 标准发行。

paragraphs.en: Caddy apps instantly benefit from automated documentation , graceful on-line config changes via API , and unification with other Caddy apps.
paragraphs.zh: Caddy 应用程序可立即受益于自动化文档、通过 API 进行优雅的在线配置更改，以及与其他 Caddy 应用程序的统一。

paragraphs.en: Although JSON is Caddy's native config language, Caddy can accept input from config adapters which can essentially convert any config format of your choice into JSON: Caddyfile, JSON 5, YAML, TOML, NGINX config, and more.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 JSON 是 Caddy 的原生配置语言，但 Caddy 可以接受来自配置适配器的输入，这些适配器基本上可以将您选择的任何配置格式转换为 JSON：Caddyfile、JSON 5、YAML、TOML、NGINX 配置等。

paragraphs.en: The primary way to configure Caddy is through its API , but if you prefer config files, the command-line interface supports those too.
paragraphs.zh: 配置 Caddy 的主要方式是通过其 API，但如果你更喜欢配置文件，命令行界面也支持使用配置文件。

paragraphs.en: Caddy exposes an unprecedented level of control compared to any web server in existence. In Caddy, you are usually setting the actual values of the initialized types in memory that power everything from your HTTP handlers and TLS handshakes to your storage medium. Caddy is also ridiculously extensible, with a powerful plugin system that makes vast improvements over other web servers.
paragraphs.zh: 与现有的任何 Web 服务器相比，Caddy 提供了前所未有的控制能力。 在 Caddy 中，你通常是在为内存中已初始化的类型设置实际值，这些类型驱动着从 HTTP 处理器和 TLS 握手到存储介质的方方面面。 Caddy 还具有极强的可扩展性，其强大的插件系统相比其他 Web 服务器有巨大的改进。

paragraphs.en: To wield the power of this design, you need to know how the config document is structured. Please see our documentation site for details about Caddy's config structure .
paragraphs.zh: 要运用这种设计的强大功能，你需要了解配置文档的结构。 有关 Caddy 配置结构的详细信息，请参阅我们的文档站点。

sents.zh: 要运用这种设计的强大功能，你需要了解配置文档的结构。

sents.zh: 有关 Caddy 配置结构的详细信息，请参阅我们的文档站点。

paragraphs.en: Nearly all of Caddy's configuration is contained in a single config document, rather than being scattered across CLI flags and env variables and a configuration file as with other web servers. This makes managing your server config more straightforward and reduces hidden variables/factors.
paragraphs.zh: Caddy 的几乎所有配置都包含在单个配置文档中，而不像其他 Web 服务器那样分散在命令行标志、环境变量和配置文件中。 这使得管理服务器配置更加简单直接，并减少了隐藏的变量/因素。

paragraphs.en: Matthew Holt began developing Caddy in 2014 while studying computer science at Brigham Young University. (The name "Caddy" was chosen because this software helps with the tedious, mundane tasks of serving the Web, and is also a single place for multiple things to be organized together.) It soon became the first web server to use HTTPS automatically and by default, and now has hundreds of contributors and has served trillions of HTTPS requests.
paragraphs.zh: Matthew Holt 在杨百翰大学攻读计算机科学期间，于 2014 年开始开发 Caddy。 （之所以选择「Caddy」这个名字，是因为这款软件能帮助处理服务网页时繁琐乏味的任务，同时也是将多种事物归置到一起的单一场所。）它很快成为首个默认自动启用 HTTPS 的网页服务器，如今拥有数百名贡献者，并已处理过数万亿次 HTTPS 请求。
